virtualHumanTrial.title: Virtual Human Material Trial
virtualHumanTrial.description: Validate facial consistency with a trusted Mobile Cloud virtual-human asset before production.
virtualHumanTrial.tip: Copy an asset URI (asset://...) from the Mobile Cloud MoMA virtual-human library. Only trusted assets are sent to Seedance 2.0; no Base64 upload or local asset is persisted.
virtualHumanTrial.assetUriHint: Use the asset://asset-id format. Public or authorized private assets are supported.
virtualHumanTrial.defaultPrompt: The virtual human turns naturally and smiles while keeping facial features, hairstyle, and clothing details consistent in a steady 4-second shot.
virtualHumanTrial.spec: The trial is fixed at 480p, 4 seconds, and silent output. It creates one preview to reduce accidental real-face moderation failures.
virtualHumanTrial.resultHint: This video is a trial only and is not saved to this app's asset hub. Continue in the video workspace with the same asset URI after confirming the result.
